newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian Imperial to apply for NYSE listing.
newsitem.headline: Canadian Imperial to apply for NYSE listing.

text.p: Canadian Imperial Bank of Commerce said on Thursday that it would apply for a listing in the New York Stock Exchange.

Canada's second largest bank said it decided to join three other Canadian banks on the New York exchange because of the growing importance of the U.S. market to CIBC and increasing interest in the stock from U.S. investors.
"The U.S. market is growing in importance to CIBC from both a customer and investor perspective," CIBC Chairman Al Flood said in a statement.

CIBC currently trades on stock exchanges in Toronto, Montreal, Vancouver, Winnipeg, and London. It will join Royal Bank of Canada, Bank of Montreal and Toronto-Dominion Bank on the New York Sock Exchange.
